guitar.evidence: Johnny Hallyday was a vocalist who worked with many different touring/session guitarists over his long career (no single fixed guitarist or iconic gear tied to him personally).

tone.target: anthemic high-gain rock crunch with bright mids
tone.profile: anthemic high-gain rock crunch with bright mids
tone.summary: A modern Marshall/Plexi style setup (UK 45) with high gain, boosted upper mids via OD9, followed by Chorus and Digital Delay to achieve an anthemic, punchy sound.
